name: TrazoForms
author: Two Digits

sections.description:
TrazoForms is a WordPress form builder for people who care how their forms look and who can use them. Every form comes accessible out of the box, adapts to light and dark mode, and can be styled without writing CSS.

Design that works everywhere

  • Eleven color palettes, starting from a neutral one in whites and greys, each with a light and a dark version. Every color pair is checked against WCAG 2.1 contrast minimums, so text stays readable on every background.
  • Light, dark or automatic mode. In automatic mode, each visitor sees the form in the mode their device uses.
  • Live preview that shows the real form, not a mockup: what you see in the builder is exactly what visitors get.
  • Six fonts to choose from, three sans serif and three serif, or use your theme’s font. They are served from your own site, never from Google, and visitors only download the one your form uses.
  • Frame and header options, including a logo and a background image, without writing any code.

Accessible by default

  • Labels, help text and error messages are correctly linked for screen readers.
  • Radio buttons and checkboxes are grouped in fieldsets with a legend.
  • A validation summary at the top of the form lists every error, with a link to each field.
  • Errors are never shown with color alone.
  • Required fields are always announced to screen readers, whichever visual marker you choose.
  • The public form works without JavaScript; JavaScript only improves the experience.

Everything you need to collect information

  • 19 field types: text, paragraph, number, email (with optional confirmation), phone, website, date, time, full name, address, dropdown, multi-select, multiple choice, checkboxes, file upload, consent, hidden field, HTML block and section break.
  • Conditional logic: show or hide fields based on previous answers. Conditions are also checked on the server, so a hidden field is never validated or saved.
  • Merge tags to include submitted values in emails and confirmation messages.
  • Two fully editable email notifications — one to the site administrator, one confirming receipt to the person who filled out the form — with their own sender, subject, message and a live preview using made-up sample data.
  • One confirmation after submitting: a message, a page on your site or a redirect to any address.
  • Nine ready-made templates: contact, survey, event registration, job application, newsletter signup, donation pledge and more.

Manage your entries

  • Search, filter, star and mark entries as read.
  • Spam and trash, with restore.
  • Internal notes that only your team can see.
  • CSV or Excel (.xlsx) export by date range, status and columns, protected against spreadsheet formula injection.
  • Integrated with the WordPress personal data export and erase tools.

Built to be safe

  • Anti-spam without CAPTCHAs, on from the first form: a hidden trap field and a minimum time to fill out the form, plus an optional block on links. Suspected spam is kept in the Spam view, without sending any email, so nothing a real person sends is ever lost.
  • A limit on how many times the same visitor can submit the same form in a short time, to stop automated floods.
  • Optionally reject duplicate values, such as the same invoice number registered twice.
  • Open and close a form on specific dates, limit the number of responses or require visitors to be logged in.

Translation ready

TrazoForms is written in English and is fully internationalized. Translations are delivered through translate.wordpress.org, so you can contribute yours there.

Privacy

TrazoForms stores the information that visitors submit in your site’s database, together with any files they upload. It does not set cookies and does not track visitors. The only external connection is the optional Freemius opt-in described below.

Freemius. TrazoForms includes the Freemius SDK, which shows a screen offering to connect your site to Freemius (freemius.com) for updates, licensing and usage information. The connection is optional: you can skip it, and the plugin works the same. If you agree, Freemius receives your site address, WordPress and PHP versions, the plugin version and your WordPress user’s name and email. See the Freemius privacy policy at https://freemius.com/privacy/.

Email notifications are sent through WordPress (wp_mail()), using whatever email service your site is configured to use.

Entries are included in the WordPress tools for exporting and erasing personal data (Tools → Export Personal Data and Tools → Erase Personal Data).

Credits

Fonts: Atkinson Hyperlegible Next, Inter, Figtree, Source Serif 4, Literata and Lora, licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1. Each license is included in assets/fonts/<font>/OFL.txt.

Icons by Lucide, licensed under the ISC License. Icons derived from Feather are licensed under the MIT License. Both licenses are included in assets/icons/LICENSE-lucide.txt.
sections.installation:
1. In your WordPress dashboard, go to Plugins → Add New and search for “TrazoForms”.
  2. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  3. Go to TrazoForms → Add New, choose a template or start from a blank form, and save it.
  4. Copy the shortcode shown next to the form title, for example [trazoforms id="1"], and paste it into any page or post.
sections.faq:
Where are the entries stored?

In your own WordPress database. TrazoForms does not send your data to any external service.

Does TrazoForms work without JavaScript?

Yes. The public form, its validation and its confirmation messages all work without JavaScript. JavaScript only adds live improvements, such as showing conditional fields instantly.

Can I use my own colors?

Choose any of the eleven palettes, and set a custom frame color or background for each form. Each palette has been checked against WCAG 2.1 contrast minimums in both light and dark mode.

What happens to my data if I delete the plugin?

By default, nothing is deleted: your forms and entries stay in the database in case you reinstall. If you want everything removed, go to TrazoForms → Settings and check Delete all data on uninstall before deleting the plugin. That removes all forms, entries, notes and files uploaded by visitors. Deactivating the plugin never deletes anything.

How do I report a security issue?

Please do not report security issues in the public support forum. Email security@twodigits.studio instead.

Does TrazoForms work with my theme?

Yes. TrazoForms forms are plain HTML and CSS with no page-builder markup, so they work inside any WordPress theme. You can also set a custom frame color or background per form to match your site.

Do I need to know how to code?

No. Every form is built with a visual builder: pick a field type, set its options, and the live preview shows exactly what visitors will see — no CSS or PHP required.

Does TrazoForms work with page caching?

Yes. The public form works without JavaScript — it is plain server-rendered HTML, which is friendly to page caching. JavaScript only adds optional live improvements, such as showing conditional fields instantly.

Is TrazoForms available in Spanish?

Yes. TrazoForms has an official Spanish (Spain) translation, delivered through translate.wordpress.org, where you can also contribute or request other languages.
